component.name: Memonotes
component.summary: Notes that sync with your Memos server

description.p: Memonotes is a calm notes app for GNOME. Write in a visual editor with formatting, checklists, tables and images, and keep everything in sync with your own Memos server.
Notes are stored locally first, so reading and editing keeps working offline. Changes are uploaded when you are back online, and conflicts are shown so you decide which version to keep.

ul.li: Multiple Memos accounts, with access tokens stored in the system keyring
Import and export of Markdown files
